governance.grain: one detected lifecycle / maintenance event per mounted position (wheelset_equipment_id)
governance.point_in_time_rule: Event detection uses only source facts with business time at or before the event measurement timestamp; no look-ahead across the event boundary.
governance.no_single_signal_authority: No lifecycle boundary is forced on a single signal. CONFIRMED replacement requires persistent diameter jump AND at least one independent corroborator.
governance.source_of_truth: Detection rules and taxonomy are governed by this specification; consumption semantics are docs/phase3c_plan.md Stage A.

event_taxonomy.definition: New physical wheel installed; persistent upward diameter jump (delta > +10 mm sustained >= 2 subsequent inspections)
Spurious measurement; diameter jump reverts within 1 inspection

Upward diameter change (delta > +3 mm) that persists but cannot be confidently resolved as a replacement (unresolved physical/lifecycle evidence). Quarantined from lifecycle-boundary claims but retained for investigation.

detection_rules.trajectory_driven: Classification is driven by the diameter trajectory (does an upward change persist or revert?), not by the presence of metadata flags.
detection_rules.downward_change: delta <= +3 mm is treated as normal within-segment wear / measurement variation and NEVER emits an event, even when wsmWheelAnalysisFlag==2 or wsmProvDate changes. Raw evidence is preserved in the evidence table.

upward_bands.small_increase: 0 < delta <= +3 mm -> measurement variation, no event
upward_bands.ambiguous: +3 < delta <= +10 mm -> investigate: persists >= 2 inspections -> UNKNOWN; reverts within 1 inspection -> ANOMALY
upward_bands.strong_jump: delta > +10 mm -> replacement candidate: persists -> CONFIRMED/LIKELY; reverts -> ANOMALY; unverified -> UNKNOWN

primary_physical_signal.name: persistent_jump
primary_physical_signal.formula: dia_i - dia_prev > +10 mm AND number of subsequent inspections within +-5 mm of the post-jump level >= 2
primary_physical_signal.diameter_source: wsmDia1 preferred, else wsmDia2, restricted to plausibility window [1000, 1100] mm

new_wheel_diameter_reference.rule: No global constant. The expected near-new wheel diameter is derived per locomotive type; a persistent upward jump that lands within +-10 mm of LotWheelDiaNew is a strong independent corroborator (signal: near_new_wheel_diameter).

corroborators.source: wsmProvDate differs from the previous inspection on the same position
post-jump diameter within +-10 mm of the locomotive type's LotWheelDiaNew
corroborators.role: independent physical corroborator (derived from geometry vs stock, not from metadata flags)

classification: delta <= +3 mm -> normal wear / variation, no event (regardless of flag2/provision)
ambiguous band + persists -> UNKNOWN (unresolved potential boundary)
ambiguous band + reverts within 1 inspection -> ANOMALY
strong jump + persists + >=1 corroborator (flag2 / provision / near_new_wheel) -> CONFIRMED replacement
strong jump + persists + no corroborator -> LIKELY replacement
strong jump + reverts within 1 inspection -> ANOMALY

strong jump + unverified, but a second upward transition lands within +-10 mm of the type's LotWheelDiaNew within the next 3 inspections -> UNKNOWN (sequential_replacement; unresolved research class, NOT forced to CONFIRMED)
strong jump + unverified (no persistence/reversion/sequential signal observable) -> UNKNOWN (unverified_jump)
detection_rules.event_timestamp: measurement_timestamp of the post-event measurement (wsmUpdatedOn resolved by Silver)

output_schema.event_date: datetime64[ns] timestamp of the post-event measurement
output_schema.persistence: int count of verified subsequent inspections at the new level
output_schema.loco_id: int64 locomotive_id resolved via Business Truth v1.0 when available
output_schema.is_lifecycle_boundary: bool whether the event starts a new lifecycle segment

validation_rules: event_type and confidence are within the enumerated taxonomy
CONFIRMED requires both persistent_jump and >=1 corroborator (never single-signal)

signals is a subset of {persistent_jump, analysis_flag_2, provision_change, near_new_wheel_diameter, transient_jump, ambiguous_upward_persist, ambiguous_upward_unverified, sequential_replacement, unverified_jump, owner_recorded_turning_flag}
manifest SHA256 recorded; inputs pinned by SHA256
delta <= +3 mm never emits an event, even with flag2/provision evidence
